_owner: design-SB — THE DESIGN ENGINE SCHEMA (the SSOT for the right side of the bow-tie). The visuals (nodes) that render the first three FINALIZED method engines (Text / Decompose / Connect) into figures. Each node carries a spec-drawer so a future LLM can re-render it into another frontend. The visual grammar + the four-check gate live in viz_principles.json (design-principles.html); this file is the node map. Sibling of method_flow.json + the *_node_drawer.json feeds. Validated by 3DR-16 (reading_room_viz_reconciliation_2026-08-10).

page.subtitle: the visuals that render the instrument's output — one grammar, many forms, each gated
page.reads: The right-side companion to the method engine. The method engine breaks a text into moves and wires them; THIS engine renders that finalized output into figures for two audiences, composing into a reading room. Each visual is a node with a spec-drawer (what it shows, which method node + feed it reads, its encoding, its four-check gate). The grammar every node obeys, and the gate every node passes, live on the design principles page. Validated by 3DR-16.

seam: This engine's INPUT is the method's FINALIZED feeds (Text=checkout.json · Decompose=moves.json · Connect=connect_node_drawer.json); the TRANSFORMATION is design-SB's. A node reads_from a feed field — it never re-authors a method fact (that was the Connect-status bug). Un-finalized engines (Situate / Frame / Gloss) are out of scope until finalized.

nodes.name: The Facing Page
nodes.one_line: what corresponds across texts — and where the correspondence breaks
nodes.encoding: two texts intact, side by side; the shared MOVE stated in a centre band; the BREAK stated directly beneath it, mandatory — a resonance without its break is not renderable. No causal arrow (RESONANCE is non-genealogical).
nodes.audience: both (the most contemplative object in the set)
nodes.composes_into: the reading room — the outer margin (distance-from-centre = epistemic distance)

nodes.name: The Ledger of Absences
nodes.one_line: the edges that are NOT there — a first-class finding, not blank space
nodes.encoding: a positive mark for a negative result: ○ = tested-and-absent, · = not assessed, — = not applicable. Every ○ carries its search-scope, so 'no edge found within the declared universe' never overclaims 'no edge exists'. Mark 16:8 itself ends in an absence — the convention rhymes with the passage.
nodes.audience: academic-first; quiet marks for readers ('nothing answers this')
nodes.composes_into: the reading room — inline empty sockets + a full register margin
